name: reachinbox-scheduler-monorepo
description: ReachInbox Email Scheduler Monorepo (Zero Docker Required)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,worker,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
